characteristics.name: Restrictions
characteristics.$text: **Leader**: You must recruit a **Pox Priest** to lead your warband at the start of the campaign.

characteristics.name: Special Rules
characteristics.$text:
- You begin the campaign with the **Desecrated Chapel** stronghold.
- Your warband can include 0-2 Pox Priest Apprentices.

characteristics.name: Special Rules

- Your warband can include 0-2 Rolling
Contraptions.

characteristics.name: Restrictions
characteristics.$text: **Leader**: You must recruit a **Nightfang Assassin** to lead your warband at the start of the campaign.

characteristics.name: Special Rules
characteristics.$text: You begin the campaign with the **Hidden Vantage** stronghold.

characteristics.name: Restrictions
characteristics.$text: **Leader**: You must recruit an **Ironfang Warlord** to lead your warband at the start of the campaign.

characteristics.name: Special Rules
characteristics.$text: You begin the campaign with the **Fortified Warren** stronghold.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: **Prayers of Plague**: Each battle, before you determine prepared spells, you can pick 1 friendly Priest in your warband. Instead of randomly determining the spell they have prepared from a Spell Lore, you can pick.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text:
**Mad Tinkerers**:
- When making an injury roll for a friendly *Contraption*, you can roll twice and pick either result.
- Before each battle begins, you can pick 1 friendly *Sparkseer*. That fighter starts the battle with 3 engineering points instead of d3.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text:
**Run the Roofs**: If the scenario instructs you to set up fighters near an entry point (for example, wholly within 6" of an entry point) you can pick up to d3 of those fighters to instead be set up on the
roofs. If you do so, these fighters can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is wholly within 12" horizontally of the centre of the battlefield, is more than 9" from all enemy fighters, and isn’t on the battlefield floor.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text:
**Fighting Pits**: After each battle, before the aftermath sequence, you can pick 2 friendly Champion or Henchmen fighters that were not taken down during the battle to fight in the pits. Resolve the fight as follows:
Pick 1 of the fighters to command and let your opponent command the other. The 2 fighters are placed engaged in melee. Roll-off and start alternating melee attack actions starting with the winner. The fighters cannot make any other actions or moves. Alternate making melee attack actions until 1 fighter is taken down. That fighter suffers an injury as normal. The other fighter is the winner and earns 10 bonus experience.

rules.name: Master of Plague Magic
rules.description:
This fighter knows the Lore of Poxes. When they are recruited, pick 2
spells from it to be their signature spells. In addition, at the start of each battle they prepare 1 random spell from it.

rules.name: Skilled Killer
rules.description: When this fighter is recruited, pick 1 skill for them.

rules.name: Ambitious Warlord
rules.description: When this fighter is recruited, pick 2 skills for them.

rules.name: Tinkerer's Know-how
rules.description: When this fighter is recruited, pick 1 skill for them.

rules.name: Spellcaster
rules.description: This fighter knows the **Lore of the Under-Tunnels**. When they are recruited, pick 1 spell from it to be their signature spell. In addition, at the start of each battle they prepare 1 random spell from it.

rules.name: Holy Magic
rules.description: This fighter knows the **Lore of Poxes**. When they are recruited, pick 1 spell from it to be their signature spell. In addition, at the start of each battle they prepare 1 random spell from it.

sharedRules.name: One-cut, One-kill
sharedRules.description: While this fighter has made a Charge Move in the same activation, its melee attack rolls score a critical hit on a natural roll of a 5 or 6.

sharedRules.name: Mad Engineering
sharedRules.description:
This fighter begins the battle with **d3 engineering points**. Once per activation, if this fighter is not engaged in melee, they can spend one of their engineering points to make the following bonus action:
**Engineer [Bonus Action]**: Pick a friendly fighter within 1" of this fighter, that is not engaged in melee, to be the target and then pick one of the following options:
- Patch-up: If the target is a Contraption, it heals d3 life.
- Soup-up: Pick 1 of the target’s ranged weapons to be *souped-up* until the end of the round. While a weapon is *souped-up*, increase it’s Rend value by 1. However if it misfires, treat the result as ‘backfire’ (do not roll on the table)

characteristics.name: Weapon Traits
characteristics.$text: Arcane, Heavy, Misfire, Rare 0-1, Two-handed, Volley

characteristics.name: Weapon Traits
characteristics.$text: Blast, Heavy, Misfire, One-use, Rare 0-1, Two-handed

rules.name: Heavy Plating
rules.description:
*Armour value (5+)*
Subtract 1 from the Move value of fighters equipped with this armour.

rules.name: Bomb Rat
rules.description:
Once per battle, while this fighter is not engaged in melee, they can make the following bonus action:
**Set Up Bomb Rat [Bonus Action]:** A Giant Rat is summoned and added to the commanding player's warband. Set up the Giant Rat fighter within 3" of the fighter and choose a number between 1 and 6. This number is the **fuse length**. Use a dice placed next to the Giant Rat to track the fuse length.
Each time that Giant Rat activates, roll a dice. If the roll is greater than the fuse length, the bomb detonates. If the roll is equal or less than than the fuse length, the Giant Rat is activated as normal and the fuse length is reduced by 1 (to a minimum of 1).
When the bomb detonates, the blast template is centred on the Giant Rat. Each other fighter in the template it is hit with the following attack, then the
Giant Rat is taken down (it does not count towards flee tests):
|Rend|Damage|
|---|---|
|-2|d3|


If the Giant Rat is taken down and the bomb has not yet detonated, roll a dice as above to see if it detonates or not.

rules.name: Clan Banner
rules.description:
While this fighter is on the battlefield, you can re-roll flee tests.
You can re-roll Willpower tests made by friendly fighters while they are within 12" of this fighter and this fighter is visible to them.

rules.name: Gas Mask
rules.description: This fighter cannot be *poisoned*.

rules.name: Net
rules.description:
Once per battle, at the start of a melee attack action in which this fighter is either the attacking or defending fighter, they can throw the net. To do so, they take an Initiative test. If passed, the enemy fighter becomes
entwined.
While a fighter is entwined, subtract 1 from the Attacks value of their melee weapons (off-hand attacks are unaffected). Each time an entwined fighter is activated, they can take an Initiative test, if passed, they are no longer entwined.

rules.name: Periscope
rules.description: While this fighter hasn't made a move in the same activation, add 5" to the Range value of their two-handed ranged weapons (excluding those with the *Flame* weapon trait).

rules.name: Smoke Bomb
rules.description:
Once per battle, while this fighter is engaged in melee, they can use the following bonus action:
**Drop Smoke Bomb [Bonus Action]**: Remove this fighter from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 6" of its previous position and not engaged in melee.

rules.name: Wheel Spikes
rules.description: Improve the Rend value by 1 on this fighter's Crushing Bulk melee weapon and the attack dealt by the 'Splat!' special rule.

characteristics.name: Normal Effect
characteristics.$text: Pick a visible friendly fighter within 3" of the caster, remove them from the battlefield and set them up again, anywhere on the battlefield within 9" of the caster and not engaged in melee, (if you pick the caster themselves, mark their location before removing them from the battlefield).

characteristics.name: Critical Effect
characteristics.$text: Increase the range the fighter can be set up from 9" to 12".

characteristics.name: Normal Effect
characteristics.$text:
Pick a visible enemy fighter within 12" of the caster to be the target. That enemy fighter is *doomed* . While an enemy fighter is *doomed* you can make them re-roll one of the following: an attack roll, a parry roll, an armour roll.
Once you do so, the fighter is no longer *doomed*.

characteristics.name: Normal Effect
characteristics.$text:
The closest visible enemy fighter within 12" is targeted and hit with the following attack:
|Rend|Damage|
|---|---|
|-1|d3|


Then, pick another enemy fighter that is within 3" of the previous target and visible to it to be the new target. It is hit with the same attack.

characteristics.name: Critical Effect
characteristics.$text: After the attack on the second target is resolved, pick another enemy fighter within 3" of the first two and visible to them, to be the third target. They are hit with the same attack.

characteristics.name: Normal Effect
characteristics.$text: Place the blast template centred on the battlefield floor within 12" of the caster. Then scatter the blast template d6". You can pick d3 friendly fighters in Reserve to be set up on the battlefield floor, in the template and not engaged in melee.

characteristics.name: Normal Effect
characteristics.$text: Until the end of the round, the caster has a 6" aura of *shadows* Friendly fighters are in cover while they are within 6" of the caster.

characteristics.name: Critical Effect
characteristics.$text: Increase the range of the aura from 6" to 9".

characteristics.name: Normal Effect
characteristics.$text:
Place the blast template centred on a visible point within 15" of the caster, it then scatters d6".
Each fighter in its area is targeted and hit with the following successful attack:
|Rend|Damage|
|---|---|
|-1|d3|


Then, the blast scatters d6" again, and every fighter in its areais targeted and hit with the above attack, (it is possible for the same fighter to be hit with an attack both times).

characteristics.name: Critical Effect
characteristics.$text: When the blast template is first placed, it does not scatter.

characteristics.name: Normal Effect
characteristics.$text:
Place the flame template from the caster. Each fighter in its area is targeted and hit with the following successful attack:
|Rend|Damage|
|---|---|
|-1|1|

characteristics.name: Critical Effect
characteristics.$text: The Damage value is d3 instead of 1.

characteristics.name: Normal Effect
characteristics.$text: Pick a friendly fighter within 6" of the caster to be the target, then pick 1 of the target’s melee weapons to be *fetid* until the end of the round. While a weapon is *fetid* it gains the *Arcane* and *Poison* weapon traits.

characteristics.name: Critical Effect
characteristics.$text: Increase the range of the spell from 6" to 12".

characteristics.name: Normal Effect
characteristics.$text: Until the end of the round, the caster has a 6" aura of *rabid fervour*. Add 1 to attack rolls for melee attacks made by friendly fighters while they are within the aura.

characteristics.name: Critical Effect
characteristics.$text: Increase the range of the aura from 6" to 9".

characteristics.name: Normal Effect
characteristics.$text: Pick a visible enemy fighter within 18" of the caster. That enemy fighter has *rotten armour* for the rest of the round. While a fighter has *rotten armour* worsen their Armour value by 1 (to a minimum of '-').

characteristics.name: Critical Effect
characteristics.$text: The target fighter has *rotten armour* for the rest of the battle.

characteristics.name: Normal Effect
characteristics.$text: Each friendly fighter within 3" of the caster heals 1 life.

characteristics.name: Normal Effect
characteristics.$text:
Place the blast template centred on a visible point within 12" of the caster, it then scatters d6".
Each fighter in its area is hit with the following attack:
|Rend|Damage|
|---|---|
|-|d3|


Each fighter hit by the spell becomes *poisoned*, (see *Poison* weapon trait).

rules.name: Unpredictable Movement
rules.description:
This fighter has a Move value of 2d6". Each time it makes a move, roll the dice to determine its Move value for that move, (for example, if this fighter makes a Run Move, first roll 2d6" to determine its Move value, then roll an
additional d6 and add it to the Move value as normal).

rules.name: Splat!
rules.description:
After this fighter finishes a Charge move, pick 1 enemy fighter they are engaged with. That fighter is hit with the following attack 3 times:
|Rend|Damage|
|---|---|
|-1|1|

rules.name: Large and Heavy
rules.description: This fighter cannot climb or jump. In addition, each time this fighter is set-up, they must be set up on the battlefield floor and they must finish each move on the battlefield floor.

rules.name: Purveyor of Poisons
rules.description: This fighter’s melee weapons gain the Poison weapon trait. If a weapon already has the Poison weapon trait, improve the Rend value of that weapon by 1 instead.

rules.name: Dirty Fighter
rules.description: Subtract 1 from parry rolls made by enemy fighters against attacks made by this fighter. In addition, each time an enemy fighter fails such a parry roll, that enemy fighter suffers 1 damage.

rules.name: Attack! Attack!
rules.description:
Once per battle, this fighter can use the following bonus action:
**Attack! Attack! [Bonus Action]**: Until the end of the round, add 1 to attack rolls for melee attacks made by friendly fighters, while they are within 9" of this fighter.

rules.name: Too Cunning to Die
rules.description: Each time you roll on the lasting injury table for this fighter, you can roll twice and pick either result.

rules.name: Master of Dark Science
rules.description: Add 3" to the Range value of ranged weapons friendly fighters are equipped with while they are within 6" of this fighter. In addition, you can re-roll misfire rolls made for friendly fighters while they are within 6" of this fighter.

rules.name: From Unseen Quarter
rules.description:
If this fighter starts the battle in reserve, when it is set up on the battlefield for the first time they can be set up anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" away from all enemy fighters. Then up to 2 friendly Henchmen that are also in reserve and will be set up in the same round, can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is within 3" of this fighter and more than 9" away from
all enemy fighters.

rules.name: Impetuous
rules.description: The first time this fighter makes a Move in battle, it can move an additional d6".

rules.name: Wall Scrambler
rules.description: This fighter can climb **high terrain** in the same manner as ladders. In addition, it can **jump** as far as its maximum move distance.

rules.name: Ambush
rules.description: Add 1 to the Attacks value of this fighter’s melee weapons while they have made a Charge Move in the same activation.

rules.name: Escape Artist
rules.description:
Once per battle, if this fighter is engaged in melee, this fighter can use the following bonus action:
**Escape Artist [Bonus Action]**: Remove this fighter from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 2d6" of its previous position and not engaged in melee.

rules.name: Back Stabber
rules.description: Improve the Rend value of this fighter’s melee weapons by 1 while it is engaged in melee with an enemy fighter that is engaged in melee with multiple fighters.

rules.name: Shadow Lurker
rules.description: While this fighter is within ½" of any terrain, it is not visible to enemy fighters more than 9" away.
